description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Shaco''' becomes [[File:Twilight Shroud old2.png|20px|link=Stealth#Invisibility|An icon representing the keyword Invisibility]] [[:Stealth#Invisibility|invisible]] for a duration, and after a 0.125-second delay, he [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|blinks]] to the target location.
description.text: Active: Shaco becomes invisible for a duration, and after a 0.125-second delay, he blinks to the target location.

description2.raw: ''Deceive's'' [[File:Twilight Shroud old2.png|20px|link=Stealth#Invisibility|An icon representing the keyword Invisibility]] [[:Stealth#Invisibility|invisibility]] breaks when '''Shaco''' uses a basic attack or casts ''[[File:Shaco Two-Shiv Poison.png|20xpx|border|link=Shaco#Two-Shiv Poison|An icon for Shaco's ability Two-Shiv Poison]] [[Shaco#Two-Shiv Poison|Two-Shiv Poison]]'', but not from casting ''[[File:Shaco Jack in the Box.png|20xpx|border|link=Shaco#Jack in the Box|An icon for Shaco's ability Jack in the Box]] [[Shaco#Jack in the Box|Jack in the Box]]'' or ''[[File:Shaco Hallucinate.png|20xpx|border|link=Shaco#Hallucinate|An icon for Shaco's ability Hallucinate]] [[Shaco#Hallucinate|Hallucinate]]''.
description2.text: Deceive's invisibility breaks when Shaco uses a basic attack or casts Two-Shiv Poison, but not from casting Jack in the Box or Hallucinate.

description3.raw: After breaking the invisibility, '''Shaco''' empowers his next basic attack within 0.25 seconds to deal '''bonus''' physical damage, which is affected by [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critical strike]] modifiers.
description3.text: After breaking the invisibility, Shaco empowers his next basic attack within 0.25 seconds to deal bonus physical damage, which is affected by critical strike modifiers.

description4.raw: '''[[File:Shaco Backstab.png|20xpx|border|link=Shaco#Backstab|An icon for Shaco's ability Backstab]] [[Shaco#Backstab|Backstab]] Bonus:''' The attack will [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically strike]] for (160% + [[File:Infinity Edge item.png|20xpx|border|link=Infinity Edge|An icon for the item Infinity Edge]] [[Infinity Edge|18%]]) damage, increased to (200% + [[File:Infinity Edge item.png|20xpx|border|link=Infinity Edge|An icon for the item Infinity Edge]] [[Infinity Edge|30%]]) if a critical strike was rolled.
description4.text: Backstab Bonus: The attack will critically strike for (160% +  18%) damage, increased to (200% +  30%) if a critical strike was rolled.

leveling3.raw:
'''Bonus Physical Damage:'''
25 / 35 / 45 / 55 / 65 (+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)

notes.raw: * If the attack would have already [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically struck]] based on '''Shaco's''' [[File:Critical strike chance icon.png|15px|link=Critical strike]] critical strike chance, the base [[File:Shaco Backstab.png|20xpx|border|link=Shaco#Backstab|An icon for Shaco's ability Backstab]] [[Shaco#Backstab|Backstab]] critical damage modifier will be overridden by the default critical damage modifier. ** [[File:Sundered Sky item.png|20xpx|border|link=Sundered Sky|An icon for the item Sundered Sky]] [[Sundered Sky|Sundered Sky's]] [[Named item effect#Lightshield Strike|Lightshield Strike]] will '''not''' interact with this(unexpected), but will be triggered as usual. * ''Deceive's'' bonus damage adds directly to the damage instance of the basic attack. * Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.
notes.text:
If the attack would have already critically struck based on Shaco's  critical strike chance, the base Backstab critical damage modifier will be overridden by the default critical damage modifier.
* Sundered Sky's Lightshield Strike will not interact with this(unexpected), but will be triggered as usual.
Deceive's bonus damage adds directly to the damage instance of the basic attack.
Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.
